Save PNG File

ffcar_png.Rd

Function to save a PNG file using default options.

Usage

ffcar_png(
  chr_file_name,
  num_width = 5,
  num_height = 5,
  chr_units = "in",
  int_res = 300
)

Arguments

chr_file_name

A character string, the path for file.

num_width

A numeric value, the width of the image (by default assumed to be in inches).

num_height

A numeric value, the height of the image (by default assumed to be in inches).

chr_units

A character string, the units for the width and height (default is 'in' for inches).

int_res

An integer value, the resolution for the image in ppi (pixels per inch).

Value

A figure saved to the specified path.

Details

Most academic journals expect figures to have dimensions in either 5 or 7.25 inches and require high-resolution images (typically 300 ppi).
